subject: Important Update: Your Flight Itinerary
body: Dear [Recipient], we are writing to inform you of an update to your upcoming flight itinerary. Due to unforeseen circumstances, there has been a minor change to your departure time. Your new flight details are as follows: Flight number XYZ123, Departure: 10:30 AM. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or require further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. Thank you for choosing our airline.
